correctness.rationale: For any \(3\times3\) matrix, \(\det(\lambda I-J)=\lambda^3-(\operatorname{tr}J)\lambda^2+P_2(J)\lambda-\det J\). The source’s displayed definitions are \(\sigma_2=\operatorname{tr}J\), \(\sigma_1=-P_2(J)\), and \(\sigma_0=\det J\), so all three nonleading signs in its printed polynomial are reversed. Direct substitution of the stated positive parameter witness makes all three equilibrium residuals zero and yields the displayed rational Jacobian. Independent exact arithmetic reproduced coefficients \((23/36,139/216,4/27)\) and the strict Hurwitz margin, so the equilibrium is locally asymptotically stable while the printed source criterion rejects it.
